The [[Eternal Alliance]] had an '''army''' that consisted of former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] soldiers, alongside [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] warriors and mercenaries.<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" /> In [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date 5.0" /> following the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]], the army also counted [[Zakuulan]]s, [[Skytrooper]]s, and [[Knights of Zakuul]] among its ranks.<ref name="Forgotten">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Forgotten World|Iokath}}</ref>
